headlines.title: Cyclospora outbreak from tainted lettuce served at Taco Bell expands
headlines.description: Investigators are now tying Cyclospora cases in Illinois, Kansas, Oklahoma, and Pennsylvania to Taylor Farms iceberg lettuce served at Taco Bell. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin explains what people need to do to stay safe.

headlines.title: FDA Advisory Panel Votes to Loosen Peptide Restrictions
headlines.description: On Thursday, an FDA advisory committee recommended easing restrictions on several peptides popular with wellness influencers and celebrities. The panelists voted in favor of putting the peptides on the FDA’s list of substances considered safe for pharmacy compounding. If the FDA follows that advice, telehealth companies are expected to ramp up marketing of the chemicals for wellness and cosmetic uses.

headlines.title: Expert Tips for Maintaining an Anti-Inflammatory Diet
headlines.description: Maintaining a healthy diet can be overwhelming, so registered dietician Keri Glassman joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to break down the best anti-inflammatory and fermented foods. Glassman recommends drinking kombucha, eating berries and vegetables, integrating extra virgin olive oil, and also shares harmful foods to avoid.

headlines.description: Fueling up properly for a workout can make a big difference on energy, endurance and recovery so TODAY nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer stops by Studio 1A with tips on what foods to eat, the effectiveness of electrolytes and caffeine and more.

headlines.title: U.S. measles cases reach 35-year high in 2026, surpassing last year’s total
headlines.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported Friday that the United States has logged 2,318 measles cases in the first seven months of this year, surpassing last year’s total of 2,289.

headlines.title: Cyclosporiasis outbreak expands to 9 states
headlines.description: The massive, multistate outbreak of cyclosporiasis has expanded to nine states, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said Friday.
